question: In 2008, Indian Space Research Organization (ISRO) began its collaboration with _____ to develop the GPS-Aided Geo Augmented Navigation (GAGAN) system to help aircrafts accurately land over the Indian airspace.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Airport Authority of India**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Indian Space Research Organization (ISRO) collaborated with the Airport Authority of India (AAI) to develop the GPS-Aided Geo Augmented Navigation (GAGAN) system. 
 
• GAGAN is a space-based augmentation system (SBAS) that uses a network of satellites and ground stations to improve the accuracy of GPS signals.
 
• It corrects for errors caused by satellite orbit, timing, and ionospheric disturbances. GAGAN also provides information about the health of each satellite. 
 
• GAGAN is designed to provide navigational services over India's Flight Information Region (FIR) and can be expanded to neighbouring FIRs.
 
• The Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) provisionally certified GAGAN in 2012. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL)
 
 
• Headquarters: Bengaluru, Karnataka
 
 
• HAL is an Indian state-owned aerospace and defence company.
 
• It is primarily involved in the design, development, manufacturing, and maintenance of aircraft, helicopters, engines, and avionics for both military and civilian sectors.
 
• HAL has been a significant player in Indian defence with projects like the Tejas light combat aircraft, Dhruv advanced light helicopter, and the manufacturing of aircraft for the Indian Air Force.
 
 
 
 
 
• Cochin Shipyard Limited (CSL)
 
 
• Headquarters: Kochi, Kerala
 
• CSL is the largest shipbuilding and maintenance facility in India, owned by the Government of India. It specializes in shipbuilding and ship repair services and undertakes the construction of ships for commercial and defence sectors.
 
• CSL is known for building India's first indigenous aircraft carrier, INS Vikrant, and for its capabilities in ship repair and maintenance for various Indian Navy and Coast Guard vessels.
 
 
 
• Pawan Hans Helicopters Limited
 
 
• Headquarters: Noida, Uttar Pradesh
 
• Pawan Hans is a leading helicopter service provider in India, serving various sectors, including offshore oil operations, tourism, pilgrimage, and medical evacuation. It also provides helicopter services to government and private entities.
 
• Pawan Hans operates a fleet of helicopters across India and is known for offering services in remote and hilly terrains where fixed-wing aircraft may not be viable.
